articles.title: High copper prices, unseasonal rains may hit consumer durables; top picks
articles.summary: The consumer durables sector is highly sensitive to economic cycles, interest rates, and changes in disposable income, as these factors directly influence consumer demand.
articles.body: In India, the market is price-sensitive too, with analysts saying that pricing plays a key role in purchase decisions.  Although the sector continues to attract new buyers, several factors, including unseasonal rains just ahead of summer, have likely dampened demand. Also, after an exceptional growth in FY2025, which saw a record growth in volumes by up to 25 per cent, led by a sharp acceleration in room air conditioner (RAC) demand, FY26 marked a phase of disruption and reset. A cooler-than-normal summer impacted sales, while the transition to new Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE) norms led to short-term cost pressures. Rising copper prices further resulted in the contraction of margins across the industry. Dealers reduce inventories by 20%  According to Yes Securities, demand for summer products moderated in March 2026 after a noticeable improvement seen in January and February. It said that channel inventory has now normalised, and dealers now remain cautious about stocking up for the upcoming season. In fact, dealers have reduced inventories by about 20 per cent compared to last year.  On the demand side, it said that some slowdown is visible, particularly from the construction segment, where purchases have been delayed in anticipation of price corrections. The brokerage also noted that while enquiries remain steady, they are not converting into firm orders, resulting in lower offtake.  Expensive copper increases input costs  Vincent K A, senior research analyst at Geojit Investments, said the revenue growth in Q4FY26 is expected to remain in the range of 8-10 per cent. Margins may stay under pressure, mainly due to a 33 per cent Y-o-Y increase in copper prices. Additionally, BEE-related price hikes of 5-10 per cent and elevated inventory levels from the weak 2025 summer season could weigh on the overall performance of the sector.  Data showed that in FY25, the extended heatwave drove room AC volumes up by 20-25 per cent Y-o-Y to around 12.5 million units, creating a high base that FY26 has struggled to match.  Shift in weather patterns  Sunny Agrawal, head of fundamental research at SBI Securities, said that the sector entered FY26 with high inventory levels, expecting strong summer demand. "But weather anomalies impacted sales across categories, particularly air conditioners," he said, adding that the RAC segment is estimated to have contracted by around 5 per cent in FY26.  He further explained that rising input costs, especially copper prices reaching record highs of $13,000 per tonne, forced manufacturers to increase prices, which in turn affected demand.  Gas shortage due to West Asia conflict reshapes demand  Additionally, in Q4FY26, gas shortages due to the West Asia conflict led to a sudden spike in demand for induction cooktops, causing temporary shifts within the kitchen appliances segment.  Despite these challenges, analysts said that FY26 represents only a short-term slowdown caused by largely external factors. They expect a low double-digit topline growth for the industry in FY27.  Vincet said that though the near-term earnings may see some pressure, the sector continues to have strong long-term growth potential, driven by rising incomes, increasing household penetration, premiumisation trends, and growing demand for smart and energy-efficient appliances.  "India is on track to become the world's fourth-largest consumer durables market by FY27, with the industry expected to grow at around 11 per cent CAGR to reach ₹3 trillion by FY29," said the analyst.  Consumer durables: Top picks  The BSE Consumer Durables Index is currently trading at about 30 times one-year forward earnings, which is a 15 per cent discount to its five-year average. According to Vincent, this presents a reasonable entry point for medium- to long-term investors as he recommended defensive compounders such as Havells, Voltas, Amber Enterprises, and PG Electroplast. Sunny said that his top picks from the sector include LG Electronics, Amber Enterprises, Voltas, Blue Star, and Havells. articles.title: Angel One Q4 FY26: Stellar Comeback with 83.50% Profit Surge
articles.summary: Angel One Ltd., India's largest independent listed retail broking house, delivered a remarkable turnaround in Q4 FY26 (March 2026 quarter), posting
articles.body: consolidated net profit of ₹320.24 crores—an impressive 83.50% surge year-on-year and 19.20% sequential growth. The strong performance marks a decisive recovery from the challenging quarters earlier in FY26, with the company demonstrating robust operational momentum across revenue streams and margin expansion.  Angel One has delivered remarkable 38.78% returns over the past month and 27.82% over the past year, significantly outperforming both the Sensex and its capital markets peer group.  The March 2026 quarter represents a watershed moment for Angel One, with revenue reaching an all-time high of ₹1,459.42 crores, marking 38.20% year-on-year growth and 9.33% sequential improvement. This performance demonstrates the company's ability to capitalise on improving market conditions whilst maintaining disciplined cost management—a combination that has driven operating margins to their highest level in two years at 41.02%.  Financial Performance: Margins Lead the Recovery  The financial performance in Q4 FY26 showcased Angel One's operational excellence across multiple dimensions. Net sales growth accelerated to 38.20% year-on-year from just 5.76% in the previous quarter, whilst sequential growth of 9.33% marked the third consecutive quarter of improvement. This revenue momentum was accompanied by exceptional margin expansion, with operating profit (PBDIT excluding other income) surging to ₹598.59 crores—the highest quarterly figure in the company's recent history.  The quality of earnings improved substantially, with PAT margin expanding to 21.94% from 16.53% in the year-ago quarter—a 541 basis point improvement. Operating margin expansion was even more pronounced, rising 857 basis points year-on-year to 41.02%. This margin improvement reflects both operating leverage benefits from revenue growth and effective cost management, particularly in employee costs which remained relatively stable despite the business expansion.  Interest costs rose to ₹133.58 crores in Q4 FY26 from ₹80.30 crores in the year-ago quarter, reflecting higher borrowing costs in the current interest rate environment. However, the company's ability to grow operating profit at a much faster pace than interest costs demonstrates strong business fundamentals and pricing power. Tax expenses of ₹119.65 crores represented an effective tax rate of 27.20%, slightly higher than the 25.97% recorded in Q4 FY25.  Operational Excellence: Return on Equity Demonstrates Capital Efficiency  Angel One's operational strength is best exemplified by its impressive average return on equity of 30.19%, placing it amongst the top performers in the capital markets sector. This metric, which measures how efficiently the company generates profits from shareholder capital, significantly exceeds industry benchmarks and reflects the asset-light, high-margin nature of the broking business model. Higher ROE indicates superior capital efficiency and the company's ability to generate substantial returns without requiring proportionate capital deployment.  Capital Efficiency: A Key Competitive Advantage  With an average ROE of 30.19%, Angel One demonstrates exceptional ability to convert shareholder equity into profits. This strong return on equity, combined with zero long-term debt on the balance sheet, positions the company favourably for sustainable growth without excessive leverage. The company's shareholder funds have grown from ₹3,038.60 crores in March 2024 to ₹5,621.40 crores in March 2025, reflecting robust retained earnings and capital appreciation.  The balance sheet as of March 2025 reveals a company in robust financial health. Shareholder funds stood at ₹5,621.40 crores, nearly doubling from ₹3,038.60 crores in the previous year. This growth was driven primarily by reserves and surplus increasing to ₹5,531.10 crores from ₹2,953.56 crores—a testament to strong profit retention and value creation. Notably, the company maintains zero long-term debt, relying entirely on equity and operational cash flows to fund growth.  Current assets of ₹12,485.28 crores as of March 2025 comfortably exceed current liabilities of ₹11,380.45 crores, providing adequate liquidity cushion. The company's fixed assets have grown to ₹465.96 crores from ₹400.00 crores, reflecting continued investment in technology infrastructure and branch expansion to support the growing client base of 13.80 million clients, including 4.30 million active clients on NSE.  The Growth Trajectory: Sustainable Long-Term Momentum  Beyond the impressive quarterly numbers, Angel One has demonstrated consistent long-term growth that underscores the structural opportunity in retail broking. Over the past five years, net sales have grown at a compound annual growth rate of 35.20%, whilst operating profit (EBIT) has expanded at 32.78% annually. This sustained growth reflects both market share gains in an expanding retail participation landscape and the company's ability to scale operations efficiently.  Five-Year Growth Trajectory  Sales CAGR: 35.20% | EBIT CAGR:  From FY20 to FY24, Angel One's revenue grew from ₹724 crores to ₹4,271 crores—a nearly six-fold increase. Net profit surged from ₹86 crores to ₹1,125 crores during the same period, demonstrating exceptional operating leverage and margin expansion as the business scaled.  The company's growth has been accompanied by improving profitability metrics. Operating margin (excluding other income) expanded from 22.00% in FY20 to 39.60% in FY24, before reaching 41.02% in the latest quarter. This margin expansion reflects both economies of scale and the company's focus on higher-margin products and services. PAT margin similarly improved from 11.90% in FY20 to 26.30% in FY24, though it moderated slightly to 21.94% in Q4 FY26.  Peer Comparison: Competitive Positioning in Capital Markets  Angel One's valuation and operational metrics compare favourably against its capital markets peers. Trading at a price-to-earnings ratio of 34.63x, the company commands a slight discount to the peer group average of approximately 41x, despite delivering superior return on equity. This valuation gap suggests potential for re-rating as the market recognises the company's strong fundamentals and growth trajectory.  Angel One's ROE of 30.19% ranks second amongst its peer group, trailing only Anand Rathi Wealth's 38.69% but significantly ahead of most competitors. This superior return on equity, combined with a relatively modest price-to-book ratio of 4.59x (well below peers like Anand Rathi at 30.44x and CRISIL at 9.91x), suggests the company offers attractive value for quality-conscious investors. The dividend yield of 2.26% is amongst the highest in the peer group, providing income alongside capital appreciation potential.  Valuation Analysis: Fair Entry Point After Recent Rally  At the current market price of ₹301.15, Angel One trades at 34.63x trailing twelve-month earnings and 4.59x book value. Whilst these multiples appear elevated in absolute terms, they must be contextualised against the company's growth profile, profitability metrics, and market position. The stock has appreciated 38.78% over the past month and 27.82% over the past year, outperforming the Sensex by 28.29 percentage points on a one-year basis.  The company's valuation grade has evolved from "Very Expensive" in early June 2025 to "Fair" currently, reflecting both stock price consolidation and improving fundamentals. At 34.63x earnings, Angel One trades at a premium to the capital markets industry average of 22x, justified by superior ROE, strong growth trajectory, and market leadership position. The EV/EBITDA multiple of 12.89x appears reasonable for a high-quality, high-growth financial services franchise.  The stock currently trades 8.27% below its 52-week high of ₹328.30 and 53.73% above its 52-week low of ₹195.90, suggesting it has recovered substantially from the lows but retains room for further appreciation. With the company demonstrating renewed momentum in Q4 FY26 and trading above all key moving averages (5-day, 20-day, 50-day, 100-day, and 200-day), technical indicators support the fundamental improvement narrative.  Shareholding Pattern: Institutional Confidence Building  The shareholding pattern reveals evolving investor sentiment, with notable shifts in Q4 FY26 (December 2025 quarter). Promoter holding decreased marginally to 28.87% from 28.97% in the previous quarter, continuing a gradual decline from 35.55% in March 2025. This reduction reflects promoter stake dilution rather than aggressive selling, and promoters maintain strong commitment with zero pledging of shares.  Mutual fund holding increased substantially to 15.74% from 14.01%, reflecting growing institutional confidence in the company's prospects. The 1.73 percentage point sequential increase suggests active accumulation by domestic institutional investors. Insurance holdings surged to 1.59% from just 0.40%, marking the most significant quarterly change and indicating fresh institutional interest following the strong Q4 results.  Foreign institutional investor (FII) holding declined to 12.45% from 14.66%, possibly reflecting profit-booking after the stock's strong rally. However, total institutional holding (FII + MF + Insurance + Other DII) remained healthy at 30.57%, providing stability to the shareholder base. The presence of 159 FIIs and 29 mutual funds demonstrates broad-based institutional participation rather than concentration risk.  Stock Performance: Outperformance Across Timeframes  Angel One has delivered exceptional returns across multiple timeframes, significantly outperforming both the benchmark Sensex and its capital markets sector peers. The stock's one-year return of 27.82% compares favourably to the Sensex's marginal decline of 0.47%, generating alpha of 28.29 percentage points. This outperformance has been even more pronounced over longer periods, with three-year returns of 136.34% versus Sensex's 30.51%, and five-year returns of an astounding 832.21%.  The recent momentum has been particularly strong, with the stock gaining 38.78% over the past month alone—a rally driven by improving fundamentals and positive sentiment following the Q4 results. Year-to-date returns of 28.47% significantly outpace the Sensex's 8.25% decline, generating alpha of 36.72 percentage points. This outperformance reflects both company-specific strength and the market's recognition of the structural growth opportunity in retail broking.  However, investors should note the stock's high beta of 1.68, indicating significantly higher volatility than the broader market. The annualised volatility of 42.43% over the past year classifies Angel One as a "High Risk High Return" stock. Whilst the risk-adjusted return of 0.66 remains positive, suggesting adequate compensation for volatility, conservative investors should size positions appropriately given the heightened price fluctuations.  Investment Thesis: Quality Growth at Fair Valuation  Angel One presents a compelling investment case built on four pillars: strong fundamental quality, positive near-term momentum, reasonable valuation, and favourable technical setup. The company's quality grade of "Good" reflects sustained financial performance, with five-year sales and EBIT growth of 35.20% and 32.78% respectively, average ROE of 30.19%, and healthy institutional participation of 30.57%.  The near-term drivers appear positive, with quarterly financial trend turning "Positive" in March 2026 and technical indicators shifting to "Mildly Bullish" on April 16, 2026. The stock trades above all key moving averages, suggesting technical strength supporting the fundamental improvement. The MACD indicator shows bullish signals on weekly charts, whilst On-Balance Volume (OBV) remains bullish on both weekly and monthly timeframes, indicating healthy accumulation.  Valuation has moderated from "Expensive" to "Fair" following the stock's consolidation in recent months. At 34.63x earnings and 4.59x book value, Angel One trades at reasonable multiples for a high-quality, high-growth financial services franchise with market leadership in retail broking. The company's ability to generate 30.19% ROE whilst maintaining zero long-term debt justifies a premium valuation relative to lower-quality peers.  Key Strengths & Risk Factors  KEY STRENGTHS  Market Leadership: Largest independent listed retail broking house with 13.80 million clients and 4.30 million active clients on NSE  Exceptional ROE: Average return on equity of 30.19% demonstrates superior capital efficiency and profitability  Strong Growth Trajectory: Five-year sales CAGR of 35.20% and EBIT CAGR of 32.78% reflect structural market opportunity  Margin Expansion: Operating margin reached all-time high of 41.02% in Q4 FY26, up from 32.45% year-ago  Zero Debt: No long-term debt on balance sheet provides financial flexibility and reduces risk  Institutional Confidence: 30.57% institutional holding with 159 FIIs and 29 mutual funds demonstrates broad-based support  Consistent Dividend: Dividend yield of 2.26% with latest dividend of ₹1.75 per share provides income alongside growth  KEY CONCERNS  High Volatility: Beta of 1.68 and annualised volatility of 42.43% indicate significantly higher risk than market  Valuation Premium: P/E of 34.63x trades at 57% premium to industry average of 22x  Promoter Dilution: Promoter holding declined from 35.55% to 28.87% over past year  FII Selling: Foreign institutional holding decreased from 14.66% to 12.45% in latest quarter  Rising Interest Costs: Interest expenses increased 66% year-on-year to ₹133.58 crores in Q4 FY26  Market Dependency: Revenue and profitability highly correlated to equity market volumes and volatility  Regulatory Risk: Subject to SEBI regulations and potential policy changes affecting broking industry  Outlook: What to Watch  POSITIVE CATALYSTS  Sustained client acquisition maintaining momentum above 4 million active clients  Operating margins sustaining above 40% level achieved in Q4 FY26  Market share gains in cash and derivatives segments  Continued mutual fund accumulation building on 15.74% current holding  Expansion into new products and revenue streams beyond traditional broking  RED FLAGS TO MONITOR  Margin compression if competitive intensity increases or regulatory changes impact pricing  Further promoter stake dilution below 25% threshold  Sustained FII selling pressure or institutional exodus  Deterioration in market volumes impacting revenue growth  Rising interest costs eroding profitability if funding costs increase further  Angel One's Q4 FY26 results demonstrate the company's ability to execute on its growth strategy whilst maintaining industry-leading profitability metrics. The 83.50% year-on-year profit growth, combined with operating margins reaching a two-year high, validates the business model's scalability and resilience. With strong fundamentals, positive momentum, and fair valuation following recent consolidation, the stock presents an attractive opportunity for investors seeking exposure to India's retail broking growth story.  The company's market leadership position, zero-debt balance sheet, and exceptional ROE of 30.19% provide a solid foundation for sustained value creation. However, investors must weigh these strengths against elevated valuation multiples, high volatility, and dependency on market conditions. The recent shift in shareholding pattern, with domestic mutual funds increasing stakes whilst FIIs reduce exposure, suggests evolving investor dynamics that warrant monitoring.  The Verdict: Quality Growth Story with Momentum  HOLD  Score: 65/100  For Fresh Investors: Consider accumulating on dips below ₹280 for long-term wealth creation. The current price of ₹301 offers reasonable entry given strong fundamentals, though waiting for 5-10% correction would provide better risk-reward. Suitable for investors with 3+ year horizon and tolerance for volatility.  For Existing Holders: Continue holding with conviction. The Q4 FY26 results validate the investment thesis, and improving operational metrics support higher valuations. Consider booking partial profits above ₹320 to manage portfolio risk, whilst maintaining core position for long-term compounding.  Fair Value Estimate: ₹330-350 (9-16% upside from current levels based on 36-38x FY27 estimated earnings)  Note- ROCE= (EBIT - Other income)/(Capital Employed - Cash - Current Investments)

articles.title: Groww vs Angel One: After up to 35% rally in a month, which stockbroker's shares should you buy now?
articles.summary: Shares of Groww and Angel One have surged 28–35% in a month, delivering strong gains to shareholders despite recent market volatility, with analysts seeing better risk-reward in one of them.
articles.body: Groww's parent has risen over 31% in 2026 so far, while Angel One is up 24%.  While users of and assess the impact of March's relentless selloff and April's recovery on their portfolios, shareholders of the two brokerages have quietly clocked strong gains. Shares of both firms have surged 28–35% in just a month, though analysts say one currently offers a more attractive risk-reward profile.  , which operates Groww, has seen its stock rise over 31% so far in 2026, while are up about 24% in the same period. Both companies rank among India's largest listed stockbrokers.  Groww is the biggest stockbroker in India in terms of active clients, with a 28% market share. It is followed by Zerodha and Angel One. Groww added about 2.66 lakh active clients in February this year, accounting for the majority of the user additions on NSE. Angel One, meanwhile, saw its investor base rise by nearly 10,000 during the month.  Why Angel One may be a better buy now  Despite Groww's strong market share, Angel One may be the better buy at this point, said Harshal Dasani, Business Head at INVasset PMS. "It offers a stronger balance of scale, earnings visibility and operating depth, with Q3 FY26 gross revenue of Rs 1,338 crore, PAT of Rs 270 crore, a client base of 35.7 million and assets under custody of Rs 1.5 trillion,” he said.  The analyst added that Angel One's 20.4% retail equity turnover market share also shows that the franchise still holds relevance in a fiercely competitive broking market. "For investors entering after a sharp run-up, that combination makes the risk-reward relatively more favourable," he explained.  On the other hand, Groww remains a very strong growth story, with Q3 FY26 revenue from operations at Rs 1,216 crore, profit at Rs 547 crore, 20.4 million transacting users, and Rs 3 trillion in customer assets, the analyst highlighted. "But that strength is already commanding a richer premium and leaves less room for disappointment. So while Groww suits aggressive investors chasing growth, Angel One appears the cleaner and more balanced bet now," he added.  Groww share price vs Angel One share price  have gained more than 9% in one week, and nearly 29% in one month. The stock is up nearly 31% in 2026 so far, and around 37% since its listing last year. The company's market capitalisation currently stands at Rs 1.28 lakh crore.  BofA Securities recently initiated coverage on Groww shares with a 'Buy' rating and a target price of Rs 235. The Wall Street firm said Billionbrains Garage Ventures is well placed to benefit from India's growing retail investor base. It expects the company to deliver revenue growth at a CAGR of 30% over FY26–FY28. The initiation comes after the stock has already gained 31% in calendar year 2026.  Angel One shares meanwhile gained around 4% in one week and more than 35% in one month. The stock is up around 24% in 2026 so far, and around 807% in five years. The company's market capitalisation currently stands at Rs 26,681 crore.  Disclaimer : Recommendations, suggestions, views and opinions given by the experts are their own. articles.title: हफ्ते के आखिरी कारोबारी दिन घरेलू शेयर बाजार में दिखी सुस्त; सेंसेक्स और निफ्टी मामूली बढ़त के साथ हरे निशान पर, जाने तजा अपडेट
articles.summary: नई दिल्ली। घरेलू शेयर बाजार में हफ्ते के आखिरी कारोबारी दिन सुस्त शुरुआत हुई है। सेंसेक्स और निफ्टी मामूली बढ़त के साथ हरे निशान पर कारोबार कर
articles.body: रहे हैं। एशियाई बाजारों और कच्चे तेल के भाव में नरमी है। सेंसेक्स शुरुआती कारोबार में 177.52 अंक चढ़कर 78,166.20 पर पहुंच गया। निफ्टी 37.4 अंक बढ़कर 24,234.15 पर पहुंच गया। शुरुआती कारोबार में रुपया डॉलर के मुकाबले 27 पैसे बढ़कर 92.87 पर पहुंच गया। आपको बता दें की वैश्विक भू-राजनीतिक चिंताओं के बीच निवेशकों के लिए एक बड़ी राहत की खबर सामने आई है। अमेरिका और ईरान के बीच शांति वार्ता शुरू होने की उम्मीदों तथा लेबनान-इजरायल के बीच 10 दिवसीय युद्धविराम लागू होने के चलते शुक्रवार को घरेलू शेयर बाजारों में सकारात्मक रुख देखने को मिला। इसके साथ ही अंतरराष्ट्रीय स्तर पर कच्चे तेल की कीमतों में आई गिरावट और विदेशी फंडों की वापसी ने बाजार की धारणा को मजबूत किया है।  वहीं बाजार का हाल और ब्रॉडर मार्केट का दबदबा शुरुआती कारोबार में 30 शेयरों वाला बीएसई सेंसेक्स 177.52 अंक चढ़कर 78,166.20 पर पहुंच गया। वहीं, 50 शेयरों वाला एनएसई निफ्टी 37.4 अंक बढ़कर 24,234.15 पर पहुंच गया। खास बात यह है कि बाजार की इस तेजी में बड़े शेयरों की तुलना में छोटे और मझोले शेयरों ने शानदार प्रदर्शन किया। निफ्टी स्मॉलकैप 100 इंडेक्स में 0.85% और निफ्टी मिडकैप 100 में 0.5% की तेजी दर्ज की गई, जबकि मुख्य सूचकांक निफ्टी 50 केवल 0.14% चढ़ा। टॉप गेनर्स: सेंसेक्स में आईटीसी, एनटीपीसी, ट्रेंट, मारुति सुजुकी, अदाणी पोर्ट्स, इंफोसिस, टेक महिंद्रा और हिंदुस्तान यूनिलीवर जैसे शेयरों में 2% तक की तेजी दर्ज की गई। टॉप लूजर्स: इसके विपरीत बजाज फिनसर्व, भारती एयरटेल और टाटा स्टील के शेयरों में मामूली गिरावट देखी गई। सेक्टोरल इंडेक्स: निफ्टी एफएमसीजी और मीडिया इंडेक्स ने 1% से अधिक की छलांग लगाई, जबकि निफ्टी मेटल इंडेक्स 0.4% टूट गया। अमेरिका के राष्ट्रपति डोनाल्ड ट्रंप द्वारा ईरान के साथ सप्ताहांत में वार्ता की संभावना जताने से कच्चे तेल के बाजार में शांति लौटी है। ब्रेंट क्रूड 1% से ज्यादा गिरकर 98.31 डॉलर और डब्ल्यूटीआई क्रूड 93.45 डॉलर प्रति बैरल पर आ गया है।  वहीं अप्रैल महीने में क्रूड का 100 डॉलर से नीचे आना भारत के आयात बिल के लिहाज से बेहद सकारात्मक है। कच्चे तेल में नरमी का सीधा असर भारतीय मुद्रा पर पड़ा। शुरुआती कारोबार में डॉलर के मुकाबले रुपया 27 पैसे मजबूत होकर 92.87 के स्तर पर पहुंच गया। लगातार 1.6 लाख करोड़ रुपये की भारी बिकवाली के बाद विदेशी संस्थागत निवेशक एक बार फिर लगातार दूसरे सत्र में शुद्ध खरीदार बने हैं। एफआईआई ने गुरुवार को 382 करोड़ रुपये के शेयर खरीदे और पिछले दो दिनों में कुल 1,048 करोड़ रुपये का निवेश किया है। जियोजित इन्वेस्टमेंट्स के मुख्य निवेश रणनीतिकार वीके विजयकुमार के अनुसार, छोटे और मझोले शेयरों में रिटेल निवेशकों की खरीदारी से तेजी है। उन्होंने निवेशकों को सलाह दी है कि लंबी अवधि के लिए लार्ज-कैप शेयरों पर ध्यान दें और मौजूदा चौथी तिमाही के नतीजों और मैनेजमेंट की टिप्पणियों पर करीब से नजर रखें। वहीं एलकेपी सिक्योरिटीज के जतिन त्रिवेदी ने आगाह किया है कि रुपये की रिकवरी अभी भी भू-राजनीतिक घटनाक्रमों पर निर्भर है। भू-राजनीतिक मोर्चे पर आ रही शांति की खबरों ने शेयर बाजार को फौरी राहत जरूर दी है। यदि अमेरिका और ईरान के बीच वार्ता किसी सकारात्मक नतीजे पर पहुंचती है और विदेशी निवेशकों का पैसा यूं ही भारतीय बाजार में आता रहता है, तो आने वाले सत्रों में यह तेजी और स्थिरता कायम रह सकती है।  मरम्मत खत्म, इंतजार खत्म: खारुन ब्रिज पर फिर शुरू हुई आवाजाही

articles.title: FMCG Stocks: कंज्यूमर सेक्टर में 52% तक ओवरवैल्यूएशन, फिर भी इन 8 स्टॉक्स पर दांव क्यों
articles.summary: बाजार FMCG Stocks: कंज्यूमर सेक्टर में 52% तक ओवरवैल्यूएशन, फिर भी इन 8 स्टॉक्स पर दांव क्यों
articles.body: FMCG Stocks: कंज्यूमर सेक्टर के शेयर इस समय बाजार में ऊंचे स्तर पर ट्रेड कर रहे हैं और वैल्यूएशन को लेकर निवेशकों के बीच चिंता भी बढ़ रही है। एक तरफ यह सेक्टर लगातार स्थिर कमाई और भरोसेमंद ग्रोथ के कारण निवेशकों का पसंदीदा बना हुआ है, वहीं दूसरी तरफ बढ़ती कीमतें यह संकेत दे रही हैं कि अब इसमें चुनिंदा और समझदारी से निवेश करना जरूरी हो गया है। मांग में धीरे-धीरे सुधार दिख रहा है, लेकिन लागत का दबाव भी बढ़ रहा है।  ऐसे माहौल में बड़ी कंपनियां अपनी मजबूत पकड़ के दम पर आगे निकल सकती हैं, जबकि छोटे और क्षेत्रीय ब्रांड्स के लिए चुनौती बढ़ सकती है। आईसीआईसीआई सिक्योरिटीज की रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक, अप्रैल 2026 में कंज्यूमर सेक्टर करीब 14 प्रतिशत ओवरवैल्यूड है, जो यह बताता है कि बाजार पहले से ही काफी उम्मीदें इस सेक्टर से जोड़ चुका है।  रिपोर्ट के अनुसार, वित्त वर्ष 2026 की चौथी तिमाही में कंज्यूमर स्टेपल्स कंपनियों ने वॉल्यूम ग्रोथ बनाए रखी। यह ग्रोथ सिर्फ मांग बढ़ने से नहीं आई, बल्कि कंपनियों ने पैकेजिंग में बदलाव और कीमतों के संतुलन का भी सहारा लिया। धीरे-धीरे शहरी और ग्रामीण मांग में सुधार के संकेत भी मिले हैं।  हालांकि इस दौरान कच्चे माल की कीमतों में तेजी देखने को मिली है। खासकर क्रूड से जुड़े इनपुट जैसे एलएबी और एचडीपीई महंगे हुए हैं, जिसका कारण खाड़ी क्षेत्र में सप्लाई से जुड़ी दिक्कतें हैं। कंपनियों ने अभी तक इस दबाव को अपने मार्जिन पर ज्यादा असर नहीं पड़ने दिया है, लेकिन रिपोर्ट का मानना है कि इसका पूरा असर वित्त वर्ष 2027 की पहली छमाही में दिख सकता है।  यह पढ़ें: ONGC और Oil India में आ सकता है बड़ा उछाल, ब्रोकरेज ने दिया BUY सिग्नल, चेक करें टारगेट्स  ऐसे लागत बढ़ने वाले माहौल में बड़ी कंपनियां आमतौर पर बेहतर प्रदर्शन करती हैं। एचयूएल, मैरिको और नेस्ले जैसी कंपनियों के पास मजबूत ब्रांड, बेहतर डिस्ट्रीब्यूशन नेटवर्क और कीमत बढ़ाने की क्षमता होती है। इससे वे लागत का दबाव झेल सकती हैं और जरूरत पड़ने पर कीमत बढ़ाकर मार्जिन बचा सकती हैं।  इसके उलट छोटे और क्षेत्रीय ब्रांड्स के लिए कीमत बढ़ाना आसान नहीं होता, जिससे उनकी बाजार हिस्सेदारी पर असर पड़ सकता है। यही वजह है कि रिपोर्ट बड़े प्लेयर्स के पक्ष में झुकाव दिखाती है।  डिस्क्रेशनरी यानी वैकल्पिक खर्च वाले सेक्टर में अलग-अलग तस्वीर देखने को मिली। ज्वेलरी सेक्टर में सोने की ऊंची कीमतों के बावजूद वैल्यू के लिहाज से अच्छी ग्रोथ रही, क्योंकि कीमतें बढ़ने से कुल बिक्री का मूल्य बढ़ गया। कपड़ा रिटेल सेक्टर में प्रदर्शन मिश्रित रहा। ट्रेंट ने कुछ कमजोर तिमाहियों के बाद करीब 20 प्रतिशत की सालाना ग्रोथ दर्ज की, जो बेहतर रणनीति और विस्तार का परिणाम है। वहीं क्यूएसआर यानी क्विक सर्विस रेस्टोरेंट सेक्टर में ग्रोथ कमजोर रही। जनवरी में स्थिति स्थिर थी, लेकिन फरवरी और मार्च में मांग में गिरावट आई, जिस पर एलपीजी से जुड़ी दिक्कतों का भी असर पड़ा। इसके उलट शराब यानी एल्कोबेव सेक्टर में प्रीमियम प्रोडक्ट्स की मांग के कारण लगातार मजबूत ग्रोथ बनी रही।  यह पढ़ें: Wipro Share Price: Q4 नतीजों के बाद क्या करें – अभी खरीदें या गिरावट का इंतजार? ब्रोकरेज की बड़ी राय  रिपोर्ट के गहराई से किए गए विश्लेषण के मुताबिक, अलग-अलग सब-सेक्टर में वैल्यूएशन की स्थिति अलग है। कंज्यूमर स्टेपल्स सेक्टर कुल मिलाकर लगभग सही वैल्यूएशन पर है। अगर आईटीसी को अलग कर दें, तो स्टेपल्स सेक्टर करीब 18 प्रतिशत महंगा नजर आता है। डिस्क्रेशनरी सेक्टर सबसे ज्यादा महंगा है और इसमें करीब 52 प्रतिशत ओवरवैल्यूएशन दिखता है। 30 साल से ज्यादा के ऐतिहासिक डेटा के आधार पर रिपोर्ट का मानना है कि स्टेपल्स सेक्टर में जोखिम और रिटर्न का संतुलन बेहतर है, जबकि डिस्क्रेशनरी में जोखिम ज्यादा है।  आईसीआईसीआई सिक्योरिटीज ने कई कंपनियों पर अपनी रेटिंग और टारगेट अपडेट किए हैं। एवीएल एग्री, बजाज कंज्यूमर, आईटीसी, ज्योति लैब्स, नेस्ले और ऑर्कला इंडिया जैसे शेयरों पर खरीद की सलाह दी गई है। कुछ कंपनियों पर एड और होल्ड की रेटिंग दी गई है, जबकि कोलगेट जैसे शेयर पर बिकवाली की सलाह भी दी गई है।  (डिस्क्लेमर: यहां दी गई राय ब्रोकरेज की है। बिज़नेस स्टैंडर्ड इन विचारों से सहमत होना जरूरी नहीं समझता और निवेश से पहले पाठकों को अपनी समझ से फैसला करने की सलाह देता है।)

articles.title: High copper prices, unseasonal rains may hit consumer durables; top picks
articles.summary: The consumer durables sector is highly sensitive to economic cycles, interest rates, and changes in disposable income, as these factors directly influence consumer demand.
articles.body: In India, the market is price-sensitive too, with analysts saying that pricing plays a key role in purchase decisions.  Although the sector continues to attract new buyers, several factors, including unseasonal rains just ahead of summer, have likely dampened demand. Also, after an exceptional growth in FY2025, which saw a record growth in volumes by up to 25 per cent, led by a sharp acceleration in room air conditioner (RAC) demand, FY26 marked a phase of disruption and reset. A cooler-than-normal summer impacted sales, while the transition to new Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE) norms led to short-term cost pressures. Rising copper prices further resulted in the contraction of margins across the industry.  Dealers reduce inventories by 20%  According to Yes Securities, demand for summer products moderated in March 2026 after a noticeable improvement seen in January and February. It said that channel inventory has now normalised, and dealers now remain cautious about stocking up for the upcoming season. In fact, dealers have reduced inventories by about 20 per cent compared to last year.  On the demand side, it said that some slowdown is visible, particularly from the construction segment, where purchases have been delayed in anticipation of price corrections. The brokerage also noted that while enquiries remain steady, they are not converting into firm orders, resulting in lower offtake.  Expensive copper increases input costs  Vincent K A, senior research analyst at Geojit Investments, said the revenue growth in Q4FY26 is expected to remain in the range of 8-10 per cent. Margins may stay under pressure, mainly due to a 33 per cent Y-o-Y increase in copper prices. Additionally, BEE-related price hikes of 5-10 per cent and elevated inventory levels from the weak 2025 summer season could weigh on the overall performance of the sector.  Data showed that in FY25, the extended heatwave drove room AC volumes up by 20-25 per cent Y-o-Y to around 12.5 million units, creating a high base that FY26 has struggled to match.  Shift in weather patterns  Sunny Agrawal, head of fundamental research at SBI Securities, said that the sector entered FY26 with high inventory levels, expecting strong summer demand. “But weather anomalies impacted sales across categories, particularly air conditioners,” he said, adding that the room air conditioner (RAC) segment is estimated to have contracted by around 5 per cent in FY26.  He further explained that rising input costs, especially copper prices reaching record highs of $13,000 per tonne, forced manufacturers to increase prices, which in turn affected demand.  Gas shortage due to West Asia conflict reshapes demand  Additionally, in Q4FY26, gas shortages due to the West Asia conflict led to a sudden spike in demand for induction cooktops, causing temporary shifts within the kitchen appliances segment.  Despite these challenges, analysts said that FY26 represents only a short-term slowdown caused by largely external factors. They expect a low double-digit topline growth for the industry in FY27.  Vincet said that though the near-term earnings may see some pressure, the sector continues to have strong long-term growth potential, driven by rising incomes, increasing household penetration, premiumisation trends, and growing demand for smart and energy-efficient appliances.  “India is on track to become the world's fourth-largest consumer durables market by FY27, with the industry expected to grow at around 11 per cent CAGR to reach ₹3 trillion by FY29. Also, the BEE transition could support medium-term profitability, as the shift toward higher star-rated products is likely to improve product mix and realisations from H2FY27 onward, partly offsetting near-term cost pressures,” said the analyst.  Consumer durables: Top picks  The BSE Consumer Durables Index is currently trading at about 30 times one-year forward earnings, which is a 15 per cent discount to its five-year average. According to Vincent, this presents a reasonable entry point for medium- to long-term investors. He added that he prefers a mix of defensive compounders such as Havells, Voltas, Amber Enterprises, and PG Electroplast.  Sunny said that his top picks from the sector include LG Electronics, Amber Enterprises, Voltas, Blue Star, and Havells. articles.title: Angel One surges on reporting 83% rise in Q4 consolidated net profit
articles.summary: Angel One is currently trading at Rs. 299.15, up by 6.75 points or 2.31% from its previous closing of Rs. 292.40 on the BSE.
articles.body: The scrip opened at Rs. 304.80 and has touched a high and low of Rs. 305.00 and Rs. 298.00 respectively. So far 845651 shares were traded on the counter.  The BSE group 'A' stock of face value Rs. 1 has touched a 52 week high of Rs. 328.30 on 05-Jun-2025 and a 52 week low of Rs. 208.90 on 13-Mar-2026.  Last one week high and low of the scrip stood at Rs. 305.00 and Rs. 272.95 respectively. The current market cap of the company is Rs. 27462.41 crore.  The promoters holding in the company stood at 28.87%, while Institutions and Non-Institutions held 30.57% and 40.56% respectively.  Angel One has reported 94.97% rise in its net profit at Rs 351.45 crore for fourth quarter ended March 31, 2026 (Q4FY26) as compared to Rs 180.26 crore for the same quarter in the previous year. Total income of the company increased by 40.49% at Rs 1,451.87 crore for Q4FY26 as compared Rs 1,033.44 crore for the corresponding quarter previous year.  On consolidated basis, the company has reported 83.50% rise in its net profit at Rs 320.24 crore for Q4FY26 as compared to Rs 174.52 crore for the same quarter in the previous year. Total income of the company increased by 38.70% at Rs 1,467.25 crore for Q4FY23 as compared Rs 1,057.84 crore for the corresponding quarter previous year.  For the year ended March 31, 2026, the company has reported 15.89% fall in its net profit at Rs 1,022.71 crore as compared to Rs 1,215.95 crore for the previous year. Total income of the company decreased by 2.15% at Rs 5,071.77 crore for year under review as compared to Rs 5,183.31 crore for year ended March 31, 2025.

articles.title: Sensex and Nifty opens in green as ceasefire optimism lifts markets
articles.summary: BSE Sensex and Nifty 50 traded higher, supported by ceasefire optimism and foreign inflows. Markets showed resilience despite global caution, with investors closely tracking West Asia developments
articles.body: Representational image. File pic  With the West Asia conflict now standing at a very critical stage, benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty on Friday were trading in positive territory during the early hours. The indices on April 17 were supported by optimism around easing geopolitical tensions and fresh foreign fund inflows.  This is a modal window.  Beginning of dialog window. Escape will cancel and close the window.  End of dialog window.  Experts, while expressing their views on the market situation amid the ceasefire, said that the temporary ceasefire between Israel and Lebanon has added to markets' optimism, with expectations that this could pave the way for renewed US-Iran negotiations, as per PTI.  The 30-share BSE Sensex climbed 177.52 points to 78,166.20 in early trade. Whereas the 50-share NSE Nifty advanced 37.4 points to 24,234.15.  Considering that the Sensex declined 122.56 points or 0.16 per cent to settle at 77,988.68 on April 16, Thursday, the marginal gain on Friday signifies that the dynamics of the stock market could remain highly volatile for the next few days.  Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) bought equities worth Rs 382.36 crore on Thursday, according to exchange data.  While the market indices on Friday rose marginally, ITC, Adani Ports, Maruti, Trent, Power Grid and Hindustan Unilever were among the major winners. On the other hand, HCL Tech, Tata Steel, Bajaj Finance and ICICI Bank were among the laggards.  Global markets  In Asian markets, South Korea's benchmark Kospi, Japan's Nikkei 225 index, Shanghai's SSE Composite index and Hong Kong's Hang Seng index were trading lower. Whereas the US markets on Thursday ended marginally higher.  V.K. Vijayakumar, Chief Investment Strategist, Geojit Investments Limited, said. "The resilience of the mother market, the US, and positive news relating to a ceasefire between Israel and Lebanon bode well for the market."  Hariprasad K., while speaking on the current market situation, said, "While US indices continue to scale record highs, supported by optimism around easing geopolitical tensions, Asian markets have opened lower, reflecting a more cautious interpretation of the same developments.”  Wall Street extended its rally, with the S&P 500 and Nasdaq closing at fresh highs on the back of improving sentiment around a potential resolution in the Middle East, he said.  An expert further added, "Reports of a temporary ceasefire between Israel and Lebanon have added to optimism, with expectations that this could pave the way for renewed US-Iran negotiations. However, Asian markets appear less convinced, trading lower as investors remain wary of how durable these developments are, especially given the fragile nature of geopolitical agreements in the region," as per PTI. articles.title: बाजार खुलते ही सेंसेक्स-निफ्टी हरे निशान पर, लेकिन रफ्तार सुस्त
articles.summary: Updated on 17 Apr, 2026 09:10 AM IST BY NARADMUNILIVE.COM  मुंबई। घरेलू शेयर बाजार में हफ्ते के आखिरी कारोबारी दिन सुस्त शुरुआत हुई है। सेंसेक्स
articles.body: और निफ्टी मामूली बढ़त के साथ हरे निशान पर कारोबार कर रहे हैं। एशियाई बाजारों और कच्चे तेल के भाव में नरमी है। सेंसेक्स शुरुआती कारोबार में 177.52 अंक चढ़कर 78,166.20 पर पहुंच गया। निफ्टी 37.4 अंक बढ़कर 24,234.15 पर पहुंच गया। शुरुआती कारोबार में रुपया डॉलर के मुकाबले 27 पैसे बढ़कर 92.87 पर पहुंच गया।  सूचकांक / मुद्रा शुरुआती बदलाव वर्तमान स्तर  सेंसेक्स 177.52 अंक की बढ़त 78,166.20  निफ्टी 37.4 अंक की बढ़त 24,234.15  रुपया (डॉलर के मुकाबले) 27 पैसे की बढ़त 92.87  वैश्विक भू-राजनीतिक चिंताओं के बीच निवेशकों के लिए एक बड़ी राहत की खबर सामने आई है। अमेरिका और ईरान के बीच शांति वार्ता शुरू होने की उम्मीदों तथा लेबनान-इजरायल के बीच 10 दिवसीय युद्धविराम लागू होने के चलते शुक्रवार को घरेलू शेयर बाजारों में सकारात्मक रुख देखने को मिला। इसके साथ ही अंतरराष्ट्रीय स्तर पर कच्चे तेल की कीमतों में आई गिरावट और विदेशी फंडों की वापसी ने बाजार की धारणा को मजबूत किया है।  बाजार का हाल और ब्रॉडर मार्केट का दबदबा  शुरुआती कारोबार में 30 शेयरों वाला बीएसई सेंसेक्स 177.52 अंक चढ़कर 78,166.20 पर पहुंच गया। वहीं, 50 शेयरों वाला एनएसई निफ्टी 37.4 अंक बढ़कर 24,234.15 पर पहुंच गया। खास बात यह है कि बाजार की इस तेजी में बड़े शेयरों की तुलना में छोटे और मझोले शेयरों ने शानदार प्रदर्शन किया। निफ्टी स्मॉलकैप 100 इंडेक्स में 0.85% और निफ्टी मिडकैप 100 में 0.5% की तेजी दर्ज की गई, जबकि मुख्य सूचकांक निफ्टी 50 केवल 0.14% चढ़ा।  प्रमुख शेयरों और सेक्टर्स का क्या हाल?  बाजार के सेक्टोरल रुख और प्रमुख शेयरों की बात करें तो स्थिति कुछ इस प्रकार रही:  टॉप गेनर्स: सेंसेक्स में आईटीसी, एनटीपीसी, ट्रेंट, मारुति सुजुकी, अदाणी पोर्ट्स, इंफोसिस, टेक महिंद्रा और हिंदुस्तान यूनिलीवर जैसे शेयरों में 2% तक की तेजी दर्ज की गई।  टॉप लूजर्स: इसके विपरीत बजाज फिनसर्व, भारती एयरटेल और टाटा स्टील के शेयरों में मामूली गिरावट देखी गई।  सेक्टोरल इंडेक्स: निफ्टी एफएमसीजी और मीडिया इंडेक्स ने 1% से अधिक की छलांग लगाई, जबकि निफ्टी मेटल इंडेक्स 0.4% टूट गया।  कच्चे तेल में नरमी और रुपये की रिकवरी  अमेरिका के राष्ट्रपति डोनाल्ड ट्रंप द्वारा ईरान के साथ सप्ताहांत में वार्ता की संभावना जताने से कच्चे तेल के बाजार में शांति लौटी है। ब्रेंट क्रूड 1% से ज्यादा गिरकर 98.31 डॉलर और डब्ल्यूटीआई क्रूड 93.45 डॉलर प्रति बैरल पर आ गया है। अप्रैल महीने में क्रूड का 100 डॉलर से नीचे आना भारत के आयात बिल के लिहाज से बेहद सकारात्मक है। कच्चे तेल में नरमी का सीधा असर भारतीय मुद्रा पर पड़ा। शुरुआती कारोबार में डॉलर के मुकाबले रुपया 27 पैसे मजबूत होकर 92.87 के स्तर पर पहुंच गया।  विदेशी निवेशकों की वापसी  लगातार 1.6 लाख करोड़ रुपये की भारी बिकवाली के बाद विदेशी संस्थागत निवेशक एक बार फिर लगातार दूसरे सत्र में शुद्ध खरीदार बने हैं। एफआईआई ने गुरुवार को 382 करोड़ रुपये के शेयर खरीदे और पिछले दो दिनों में कुल 1,048 करोड़ रुपये का निवेश किया है। जियोजित इन्वेस्टमेंट्स के मुख्य निवेश रणनीतिकार वीके विजयकुमार के अनुसार, छोटे और मझोले शेयरों में रिटेल निवेशकों की खरीदारी से तेजी है। उन्होंने निवेशकों को सलाह दी है कि लंबी अवधि के लिए लार्ज-कैप शेयरों पर ध्यान दें और मौजूदा चौथी तिमाही के नतीजों और मैनेजमेंट की टिप्पणियों पर करीब से नजर रखें। वहीं एलकेपी सिक्योरिटीज के जतिन त्रिवेदी ने आगाह किया है कि रुपये की रिकवरी अभी भी भू-राजनीतिक घटनाक्रमों पर निर्भर है।  अब आगे क्या?  भू-राजनीतिक मोर्चे पर आ रही शांति की खबरों ने शेयर बाजार को फौरी राहत जरूर दी है। यदि अमेरिका और ईरान के बीच वार्ता किसी सकारात्मक नतीजे पर पहुंचती है और विदेशी निवेशकों का पैसा यूं ही भारतीय बाजार में आता रहता है, तो आने वाले सत्रों में यह तेजी और स्थिरता कायम रह सकती है।  BSE Sensex

articles.title: Retail Broking Company Reports FY26 Results; Q4 Profit Rises 84% YoY
articles.summary: Angel One reports 9.7 per cent QoQ income growth and 83.5 per cent YoY PAT growth in Q4; net worth rises while leverage increases, board approves Rs 20,000 crore borrowing limit and Rs 1,500 crore NCD issuance
articles.body: ✨ AI Powered Summary  On Friday, Indian markets traded on a positive note, with the Nifty 50 rising 0.30 per cent to 24,269.25, up 72.50 points from the previous close of 24,196.75. Amid this, share price was trading at Rs 300.65 as of 10:14 AM, up 2.75 per cent from the previous close of Rs 292, following the announcement of its Q4FY26 and FY26 results. The stock movement comes alongside the company's latest financial performance  Every portfolio needs a growth engine. DSIJ's Flash News Investment (FNI) provides weekly stock market insights and recommendations, tailored for both short-term traders and long-term investors. Download PDF Service Note Here  Angel One Q4FY26 Results: QoQ and YoY Performance  On a QoQ basis, total income increased to Rs 1,467.2 crore in Q4FY26 from Rs 1,337.7 crore in Q3FY26, registering a growth of around 9.7 per cent. Profit after stood at Rs 320.2 crore, up from Rs 268.7 crore in the previous quarter, representing approximately 19.2 per cent growth.  On a YoY basis, total income rose to Rs 1,467.2 crore from Rs 1,057.8 crore in Q4FY25, marking a growth of about 38.7 per cent. Profit after tax increased to Rs 320.2 crore from Rs 174.5 crore, indicating a growth of around 83.5 per cent.  Angel One FY26 Financial Performance (YoY)  For the full financial year FY26, total income declined to Rs 5,152.2 crore from Rs 5,247.7 crore in FY25, reflecting a decline of around 1.8 per cent.  Profit after tax stood at Rs 915.1 crore compared to Rs 1,172.1 crore in FY25, marking a decline of approximately 21.9 per cent.  Balance Sheet and Leverage Position  The company reported an increase in net worth to around Rs 6,148.9 crore as of March 31, 2026, compared to Rs 5,639.1 crore in the previous year. However, leverage increased, with the debt-equity ratio rising to 1.28x from 0.60x in FY25. Total debt to total assets also increased to 0.33x from 0.20x  Angel One Key Developments  During the quarter, Angel One Ltd raised Rs 50 crore through a private placement of Non-Convertible Debentures (NCDs). The board also approved an increase in borrowing limits up to Rs 20,000 crore, subject to shareholder approval.  Further, the company approved raising funds of up to Rs 1,500 crore through the issuance of Non-Convertible Debentures (NCDs), to be executed in one or more tranches on a private placement basis.  Additionally, Angel One Ltd incorporated a joint venture, Angel One LivWell Life Insurance LTD, in which it holds a 26 per cent stake. articles.title: ISGEC Heavy Engineering Stock Jumps 3.4% As It Signs MOU with Nigeria for Sugar Plant Development
articles.summary: Synopsis:ISGEC Heavy Engineering signs MOU with Nigeria's National Sugar Development Council for sugar plant feasibility studies, asset valuation, and technical support, marking its Africa expansion as shares rise 5.33%.
articles.body: Indian heavy engineering major steps into Africa with a government-backed technical pact. ISGEC Heavy Engineering Limited has sealed a major deal with the Nigerian government. On April 16, 2026, the Yamunanagar-based company signed a Memorandum of Understanding with the National Sugar Development Council (NSDC) of the Federal Republic of Nigeria. The agreement opens a new chapter for the company in Africa's largest economy.  Limited's stock, with a market capitalisation of Rs. 7,677 crores, rose to Rs. 1,071, up of 3.44 percent from its previous closing price of Rs. 1,035.40. Furthermore, the stock over the past year has given a negative return of 4.2 percent, though it recovered about 17.6 percent over the last six months.  Under the agreement, ISGEC will provide full technical support to Nigeria's sugar sector. The company will carry out feasibility studies and prepare detailed cost estimates. It will also assess and value existing assets, and offer technical solutions for both greenfield and brownfield sugar plant projects. Additionally, ISGEC will provide training to local teams. The scope is wide covering everything from design to deployment.  The National Sugar Development Council is no small body. It is the central government agency that drives Nigeria's entire sugar industry. The Council runs the country's National Sugar Master Plan. This plan guides production targets, investment flows, and the push to build local sugarcane cultivation. The NSDC also supervises major sugar companies and manages import levies. It uses those funds to reduce Nigeria's dependence on imported raw sugar over time.  For ISGEC, therefore, the deal is more than a single contract it is a gateway. The company will gain access to fresh project opportunities across Nigeria's growing sugar sector. It will also build visibility across the African continent, a market it has long served through exports. ISGEC already has a strong global footprint, having supplied over 375,000 units of liquified gas containers to more than 65 countries worldwide. Groww Africa is now firmly in focus.  बाजार के सेक्टोरल रुख और प्रमुख शेयरों की बात करें तो स्थिति कुछ इस प्रकार रही:  टॉप गेनर्स: सेंसेक्स में आईटीसी, एनटीपीसी, ट्रेंट, मारुति सुजुकी, अदाणी पोर्ट्स, इंफोसिस, टेक महिंद्रा और हिंदुस्तान यूनिलीवर जैसे शेयरों में 2% तक की तेजी दर्ज की गई।  टॉप लूजर्स: इसके विपरीत बजाज फिनसर्व, भारती एयरटेल और टाटा स्टील के शेयरों में मामूली गिरावट देखी गई।  सेक्टोरल इंडेक्स: निफ्टी एफएमसीजी और मीडिया इंडेक्स ने 1% से अधिक की छलांग लगाई, जबकि निफ्टी मेटल इंडेक्स 0.4% टूट गया।  कच्चे तेल में नरमी और रुपये की रिकवरी  अमेरिका के राष्ट्रपति डोनाल्ड ट्रंप द्वारा ईरान के साथ सप्ताहांत में वार्ता की संभावना जताने से कच्चे तेल के बाजार में शांति लौटी है। ब्रेंट क्रूड 1% से ज्यादा गिरकर 98.31 डॉलर और डब्ल्यूटीआई क्रूड 93.45 डॉलर प्रति बैरल पर आ गया है। अप्रैल महीने में क्रूड का 100 डॉलर से नीचे आना भारत के आयात बिल के लिहाज से बेहद सकारात्मक है। कच्चे तेल में नरमी का सीधा असर भारतीय मुद्रा पर पड़ा। शुरुआती कारोबार में डॉलर के मुकाबले रुपया 27 पैसे मजबूत होकर 92.87 के स्तर पर पहुंच गया।  विदेशी निवेशकों की वापसी  लगातार 1.6 लाख करोड़ रुपये की भारी बिकवाली के बाद विदेशी संस्थागत निवेशक एक बार फिर लगातार दूसरे सत्र में शुद्ध खरीदार बने हैं। एफआईआई ने गुरुवार को 382 करोड़ रुपये के शेयर खरीदे और पिछले दो दिनों में कुल 1,048 करोड़ रुपये का निवेश किया है। जियोजित इन्वेस्टमेंट्स के मुख्य निवेश रणनीतिकार वीके विजयकुमार के अनुसार, छोटे और मझोले शेयरों में रिटेल निवेशकों की खरीदारी से तेजी है। उन्होंने निवेशकों को सलाह दी है कि लंबी अवधि के लिए लार्ज-कैप शेयरों पर ध्यान दें और मौजूदा चौथी तिमाही के नतीजों और मैनेजमेंट की टिप्पणियों पर करीब से नजर रखें। वहीं एलकेपी सिक्योरिटीज के जतिन त्रिवेदी ने आगाह किया है कि रुपये की रिकवरी अभी भी भू-राजनीतिक घटनाक्रमों पर निर्भर है।  अब आगे क्या?  भू-राजनीतिक मोर्चे पर आ रही शांति की खबरों ने शेयर बाजार को फौरी राहत जरूर दी है। यदि अमेरिका और ईरान के बीच वार्ता किसी सकारात्मक नतीजे पर पहुंचती है और विदेशी निवेशकों का पैसा यूं ही भारतीय बाजार में आता रहता है, तो आने वाले सत्रों में यह तेजी और स्थिरता कायम रह सकती है।

articles.title: Shares Edge Higher Ahead of US-Iran Talks; IT, Insurance Stocks Weigh
articles.summary: The IT index slips, led by a 3 per cent fall in Wipro after the company reported subdued quarterly results
articles.body: Indian equities traded higher on Friday, supported by optimism ahead of renewed US-Iran peace talks and softer oil prices, although losses in select heavyweight stocks capped further gains.  The Nifty 50 rose 0.34 per cent to 24,279, while the BSE Sensex added 0.38 per cent to 78,290 in morning trade.  Both indices have gained about 1 per cent so far this week, following a sharp 6 per cent rally last week, their strongest weekly performance in over five years.  Market breadth remained strong, with 14 of the 16 major sectors advancing. Broader markets also participated in the rally, with mid-cap and small-cap indices rising around 1 per cent each.  “A significant and distinct trend in the market is the strength of the mid and small caps relative to the large caps. Fear of FIIs again turning sellers on rallies is weighing on large caps. In the near-term, therefore, the broader market may do better aided by the fund flows and retail buying in the segment,” said VK Vijayakumar, Chief Investment Strategist, Geojit Investments.  However, the prospects of largecaps are better in the medium to long-term. Investors should monitor Q4 results and management commentary to pick stocks in this results season, he added.  However, gains were capped by weakness in IT and insurance stocks. The IT index slipped 0.2 per cent, led by a 3 per cent fall in Wipro after the company reported subdued quarterly results and flagged muted demand from U.S. banking and financial clients.  Shares of HDFC Life Insurance declined 3.2 per cent after the company reported a drop in new business value for the quarter, despite a marginal increase in profit. Both stocks were among the top losers on the Nifty 50.  Elsewhere in Asia, markets excluding Japan fell 0.9 per cent but remained on track for weekly gains, as investors awaited the outcome of the US-Iran talks scheduled over the weekend.  Brent crude prices continued to remain below the USD 100 per barrel mark for the ninth consecutive session, offering relief to India, the world's third-largest oil importer.  Analysts expect the Nifty 50 to trade in the range of 23,400 to 24,400 in the near term, as investors assess the progress of geopolitical developments and upcoming earnings from key lenders such as HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank. articles.title: IndiGo Picks Stake in Air Taxi Startup Sarla Aviation
articles.summary: IndiGo, through its investment arm IndiGo Ventures, has acquired a ?10 crore equity stake in the Bengaluru-based air taxi startup Sarla Aviation. This strategic move marks IndiGo's direct entry into India's emerging urban air mobility (UAM) sector after its previous partnership with US-based Archer Aviation fell through due to delivery timeline delays.
articles.body: The investment was finalized in January 2026 at the same valuation as Sarla Aviation's previous $10 million funding round led by Accel. Sarla Aviation is also supported by high-profile investors including Binny Bansal (Flipkart), Nikhil Kamath (Zerodha), and Sriharsha Majety (Swiggy).  The fresh capital is intended for R&D, meeting general operating costs, and expanding business operations.  Sarla Aviation is developing an electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) aircraft named “Shunya”. Designed to carry up to 6 passengers (plus the pilot) with a total payload capacity of 680 kilograms. The aircraft targets a top speed of 250 km/h and is optimized for short urban trips (20–30 km), potentially cutting travel time from Bengaluru airport to Electronics City to just 19 minutes.  Commercial operations are planned to begin in Bengaluru by 2028, with subsequent expansion to Mumbai, Delhi, and Pune. It is designed to operate from existing helipads at hotels, hospitals, and tech parks, reducing the need for new infrastructure development.  The startup announced plans for a ?1,300 crore, 500-acre aerospace facility in Andhra Pradesh to produce up to 1,000 aircraft annually. It has collaborated with Cochin International Airport to explore vertiport infrastructure and route planning for tourism-heavy areas like Munnar and Alleppey.  Posted in  India

articles.title: Small-Cap Segment Surges with Strong Breadth and Upgrades Boosting Sentiment
articles.summary: The small-cap segment, represented by the BSE SMALLCAP 250 index, has demonstrated robust performance in recent trading sessions, advancing 1.07% today and surging 4.09% over the past five days. This rally is underpinned by broad market participation and notable sectoral trends, signalling renewed investor confidence in smaller companies amid a cautiously optimistic market environment.
articles.body: Small-Cap Index Performance and Market Breadth  The BSE SMALLCAP 250 index has emerged as the best-performing market capitalisation segment in the current phase, outpacing mid-cap and large-cap indices. The index's 1.07% gain today adds to a strong five-day rally of 4.09%, reflecting sustained buying interest. This momentum is supported by a healthy advance-decline ratio, with 201 stocks advancing against 48 declining, resulting in a robust 4.19x ratio. Such breadth indicates that the rally is not confined to a handful of stocks but is broadly based across the small-cap universe.  Among individual stocks, Nava has been the standout performer, delivering an impressive return of 11.42% over the recent period. Conversely, Afcons Infrastructure has lagged, posting a decline of 3.76%, highlighting pockets of weakness within the segment. This divergence underscores the importance of selective stock picking in the small-cap space, where volatility can be pronounced.  Sectoral Trends Driving Small-Cap Gains  While the small-cap index broadly advances, sectoral trends reveal nuanced dynamics. The industrial and infrastructure-related stocks have shown mixed results, with Afcons Infrastructure's underperformance contrasting with other infrastructure names that have contributed positively. Meanwhile, sectors such as pharmaceuticals and metals have gained traction, supported by recent upgrades and technical improvements in key stocks.  Notably, several small-cap stocks have seen their ratings upgraded recently, signalling improving fundamentals and technical outlooks. Hindustan Copper, Emcure Pharma, HEG, and Elgi Equipments have all been upgraded from Hold to Buy, reflecting enhanced earnings prospects and positive market sentiment. Emcure Pharma's technical stance has shifted from neutral to bullish, while Aadhar Housing Finance and Angel One have moved from mildly bearish to mildly bullish, indicating strengthening momentum in these names. Don't miss out on this ride!  - Strongest current momentum  - Market-cycle outperformer  - Aquaculture sector strength  Upcoming Earnings and Market Implications  Investor focus is also turning towards upcoming earnings announcements from several small-cap companies, which could provide fresh catalysts for the segment. Network18 Media is scheduled to declare results on 18 Apr 2026, followed by PNB Housing on 20 Apr, Tata Investment Corporation and TRIL on 21 Apr, and Maharashtra Scooters on 22 Apr. These results will be closely watched for signs of earnings recovery or stress, which could influence small-cap valuations and sectoral rotations.  The anticipation of these earnings releases has contributed to cautious optimism, with investors positioning ahead of potential positive surprises. The upgrades in technical calls for stocks such as Netweb Technologies and Shyam Metalics, moving from neutral to bullish or mildly bullish, further support the notion of improving market sentiment within the small-cap space.  Technical and Sentiment Indicators  Technical indicators within the small-cap index suggest a constructive trend. The advance-decline ratio above 4x is a strong breadth signal, indicating that the majority of stocks are participating in the rally. This breadth is often a precursor to sustained uptrends, as it reflects widespread investor confidence rather than isolated gains.  Moreover, the recent upgrades in technical calls for several stocks from neutral or bearish to bullish or mildly bullish reflect improving momentum and reduced downside risk. This shift in technical sentiment is critical for small-cap stocks, which tend to be more sensitive to market sentiment and liquidity conditions.  Thinking about ? The strong breadth, coupled with sectoral upgrades and improving technical momentum, suggests that the rally has a solid foundation. However, selective stock picking remains crucial given the inherent volatility and divergence within the segment.  Upcoming earnings announcements will be key to sustaining this momentum, as positive results could reinforce investor confidence and attract further inflows. Conversely, any disappointments may trigger profit-taking and increased volatility. Investors should monitor technical signals closely, as recent upgrades indicate a shift towards a more bullish stance in several small-cap stocks.  Overall, the small-cap index's 4.09% gain over the past five days and the strong advance-decline ratio highlight a market environment favouring smaller companies with improving fundamentals and technical profiles. articles.title: Stock Market Update: Nifty 50, Sensex Likely to Open Flat, Key Levels to Watch
articles.summary: The Indian stock market is set for a flat open on Friday, with GIFT Nifty trading at 24,174 — up 3 points from its previous close — as mixed global cues offset US-Iran peace talk optimism.
articles.body: On Thursday, indices opened higher but gave up gains through the session on profit booking. The Sensex fell 122.56 points or 0.16% to close at 77,988.68, while the Nifty 50 settled at 24,196.75, down 34.55 points or 0.14%.  Oil prices also slipped in early trade, with Brent crude down 1.35% to $98.05 per barrel and WTI falling 1.74% to $93.40.  FIIs remained net buyers for a second straight session on Thursday, picking up equities worth Rs. 382 crore.  Sensex Outlook  The Sensex formed a long-bodied bearish candle with a lower shadow on the daily chart.  Shrikant Chouhan, Head Equity Research at Kotak Securities, said, "We are of the view that the 78,500-78,700 zone would act as an immediate resistance for the bulls. As long as the market is trading below this, the correction formation is likely to continue. On the downside, the market could retest levels of 77,300-77,000."  Nifty 50 Outlook  The Nifty 50 also formed a bearish candle on the daily after the index could not decisively break above the 24,300 level.  Rajesh Bhosale, Technical Analyst at Angle One, said the session can be seen as a mild pause for the bulls after a sharp rally of over 2000 points in the last few weeks.  This was largely expected as prices moved closer to the key supply zone of 24,400-24,600, a resistance marked by key moving averages (50-89 EMA) and the 61.8% Fibonacci retracement.  He said, "While there are no immediate signs of weakness, a fresh leg of momentum would require a decisive breakout above this resistance zone, which could pave the way for the next phase of the rally. Until then, prices are likely to consolidate within a range, which would be considered healthy after the recent sharp upmove. On the downside, the bullish gap in the 24,000-23,900 zone continues to act as immediate support.”  Also Read US Stock Market Today: Wall Street Holds Near Record Highs as Oil Rises, Earnings Weigh  Bank Nifty Outlook  Bank Nifty dropped 215.55 points or 0.38% on Thursday to settle at 56,086.50, with the daily chart showing a bearish candle with small shadows on both sides.  Immediate resistance can be seen at 57,000; a sustained close above this level is likely to trigger further momentum, potentially leading the index towards the 58,000-59,200 zone.  On the downside, 55,600-55,500 will act as a key support zone. A break below could drag the index further toward 55,000.

articles.body: बाजार शेयर बाजार Wipro Share Price: Q4 नतीजों के बाद क्या करें – अभी खरीदें या गिरावट का इंतजार? ब्रोकरेज की बड़ी राय  Last Updated- April 17, 2026 | 10:59 AM IST  Wipro Share Price: आईटी सेक्टर की दिग्गज कंपनी विप्रो के शेयर बीएसई पर कारोबार के दौरान 3.6 प्रतिशत तक गिरकर 202.6 रुपये प्रति शेयर के इंट्रा-डे निचले स्तर पर पहुंच गए। हालांकि, सुबह 10:23 बजे तक शेयर में कुछ रिकवरी आई और यह 2.55 प्रतिशत की गिरावट के साथ 204.85 रुपये पर कारोबार कर रहा था। इसकी तुलना में बीएसई सेंसेक्स 0.41 प्रतिशत चढ़कर 78,302.51 पर था।  आईटी कंपनी की तरफ से गुरुवार को बाजार बंद होने के बाद जारी किये गए वित्त वर्ष 2025-26 के मार्च तिमाही नतीजों के बाद शेयर में बिकवाली देखने को मिली। शेयर में जारी गिरावट के बीच ब्रोकरेज हाउसेस ने स्टॉक पर अपनी राय जारी कर दी है। उनका कहना है कि एग्जीक्यूशन में और सुधार तथा डील के कुल कॉन्ट्रैक्ट वैल्यू (TCV) का राजस्व में स्थिर ट्रांसफॉर्मेशन सकारात्मक दृष्टिकोण के लिए महत्वपूर्ण है।  Wipro पर मोतीलाल ओसवाल का टारगेट प्राइस: ₹215  मोतीलाल ओसवाल ने विप्रो पर अपनी ‘न्यूट्रल' रेटिंग को बरकरार रखा है। हालांकि, ब्रोकरेज ने स्टॉक पर अपना टारगेट प्राइस मामूली बढ़ाकर 215 रुपये कर दिया है। पहले यह 210 रुपये था। विप्रो के शेयर गुरुवार को 210 रुपये पर बंद हुए।  ब्रोकरेज का अनुमान है कि वित्त वर्ष 2026-27 (FY27E) में सालाना आधार पर स्थिर मुद्रा (CC) पर राजस्व वृद्धि 1 प्रतिशत रहेगी। इसमें कमजोर शुरुआत और शॉर्ट टर्म में चुनौतियां जैसे डील के शुरू होने में देरी, बड़े ग्राहकों में गिरावट और विभिन्न क्षेत्रों में कमजोरी को ध्यान में रखा गया है।  ब्रोकरेज का मानना है कि मार्जिन बढ़ाने की गुंजाइश भी सीमित है। ऐसा इसलिए क्योंकि वेतन वृद्धि, कम मार्जिन वाले डील्स का बढ़ना और एआई में जारी निवेश दबाव बना रहे हैं।  Wipro पर नोमुरा का टारगेट प्राइस: ₹250  ब्रोकरेज फर्म नोमुरा ने विप्रो को अपनी ‘BUY' रेटिंग को बरकरार रखा है। ब्रोकरेज ने स्टॉक पर टारगेट प्राइस बढ़ाकर 250 रुपये कर दिया है। यह पहले 240 रुपये था। यह टारगेट प्राइस शेयर के मौजूदा भाव से करीब 19 फीसदी ज्यादा है।  ब्रोकरेज का ने वित्त वर्ष 2026-27 और 2027-28 के लिए आय के अनुमान में 1-2 प्रतिशत की बढ़ोतरी भी की है और उम्मीद जताई है कि डिविडेंड यील्ड शेयर को सहारा देगी।  Wipro पर एमके ग्लोबल का टारगेट प्राइस: ₹210  एमके ग्लोबल ने विप्रो पर ‘Reduce' रेटिंग को बरकरार रखा है। ब्रोकरेज ने स्टॉक पर 210 रुपये का टारगेट प्राइस रखा है। यह शेयर के पिछले बंद भाव के बराबर है।  एमके ने कहा कि विप्रो ने एक और कमजोर राजस्व प्रदर्शन वाली तिमाही दर्ज की है। इसका कारण कुछ बड़े डील्स के शुरू होने में देरी और बीएफएसआई सेगमेंट के कुछ खातों में लगातार कमजोरी है। आईटी सर्विसेज का राजस्व तिमाही आधार पर 0.6 प्रतिशत बढ़कर 2.6 अरब डॉलर रहा, जो स्थिर मुद्रा (CC) आधार पर 0.2 प्रतिशत है और एमके के अनुमान से कम है।  Wipro पर नुवामा का टारगेट प्राइस: ₹255  नुवामा ने विप्रो पर BUY की सलाह को बरकरार रखा है। साथ ही आईटी शेयर पर टारगेट प्राइस बढ़ाकर 255 रुपये कर दिया है। जबकि पहले यह 240 रुपये था।  ब्रोकरेज ने कहा कि विप्रो का कमजोर पहली तिमाही (Q1) का गाइडेंस वित्त वर्ष 2026-27 की शुरुआत को कमजोर बना सकता है। हालांकि, मार्जिन मजबूत बना हुआ है और वैल्यूएशन वित्त वर्ष 2026-27 के अनुमानित आय के मुकाबले 15 गुना पी/ई पर आकर्षक है। खरीदारी की सलाह बरकरार रखी गई है, क्योंकि मौजूदा स्तर पर कम मूल्यांकन और बड़ा बायबैक इसे निवेश के लिए आकर्षक बनाता है।  Wipro Q4 Results  वित्त वर्ष 2026 की चौथी तिमाही में विप्रो का शुद्ध लाभ एक साल पहले की तुलना में 1.9 फीसदी घटकर 3,502 करोड़ रुपये रहा। पिछले साल की इसी तिमाही में कंपनी के राजस्व में इजाफा हुआ था। हालांकि तिमाही आधार पर राजस्व 12.3 फीसदी बढ़ा है।  31 मार्च को समाप्त तिमाही में राजस्व पिछले साल की इसी अवधि की तुलना में 7.7 प्रतिशत बढ़कर 24,236 करोड़ रुपये हो गया। तिमाही आधार पर राजस्व में 2.9 प्रतिशत की वृद्धि हुई। ब्लूमबर्ग के विश्लेषकों के अनुमान से लाभ का आंकड़ा थोड़ा ही कुछ कम रहा, जबकि राजस्व उम्मीदों से कम रहा। ब्लूमबर्ग के विश्लेषकों ने 24,269 करोड़ रुपये के राजस्व के साथ 3,501 करोड़ रुपये के शुद्ध लाभ का अनुमान जताया था।  स्थिर मुद्रा के आधार पर आईटी सेवा खंड के राजस्व में पिछले साल की तुलना में 0.2 प्रतिशत की गिरावट आई और तिमाही रूप से 0.2 प्रतिशत की वृद्धि हुई। मुख्य कार्या​धिकारी श्रीनि पालिया ने आईटी सेवा राजस्व में गिरावट के लिए कई कारणों को जिम्मेदार बताया। इनमें भू-राजनीतिक अनिश्चितताएं और ग्राहकों से जुड़े मुद्दे शामिल हैं, जिन्होंने कुछ बड़े सौदों को पूरा होने से रोका।  (डिस्क्लमेर: यहां शेयर में सलाह ब्रोकरेज ने दी है। बाजार में निवेश जो​खिमों के अधीन है। निवेश संबंधी फैसला करने से पहले अपने एडवाइजर से परामर्श कर लें।)  First Published - April 17, 2026 | 10:59 AM IST  संबंधित पोस्ट

articles.title: Indian Stock Markets Open Flat, Broader Markets Outperform Amid Mixed Global Cues
articles.summary: Indian Markets End the Week on a Flat Note  The Indian benchmark indices, Sensex and Nifty, opened marginally higher on Friday, but soon turned flat-to-negative.
articles.body: Despite this, broader markets outperformed benchmark indices amid mixed global cues and continued preference for mid- and small-cap stocks.  In the early morning trade, the Sensex rose 0.19 percent to 78,134.10, while the Nifty 50 was up 0.09 percent at 24,217.35. The modest gains reflect a cautious start despite positive signals from US markets.  Market Index  Previous Close  Current Close  Percentage Change  Nifty Midcap 100  Nifty Smallcap 100  Nifty Next 50  Read also: Indian Stock Market Surges 350 Points Amid Easing Geopolitical Concerns  The Nifty Midcap 100 and Nifty Smallcap 100 led the gains with 0.43 percent and 0.72 percent increases, respectively. The Nifty Next 50 also gained 0.35 percent, indicating sustained buying interest beyond frontline stocks.  VK Vijayakumar, Chief Investment Strategist at Geojit Investments, noted that a significant trend in the market is the strength of mid and small-cap stocks relative to large caps. He added that fears of foreign institutional investors (FIIs) turning sellers on rallies are weighing on large-cap stocks, while fund flows and retail participation are supporting the broader market.  Sectorally, performance was mixed. Nifty FMCG led gains with a 1.06 percent rise, followed by Nifty Media (up 1.44 percent) and Nifty Energy (up 0.66 percent). On the other hand, Nifty Metal slipped 0.25 percent, while Nifty Financial Services remained marginally under pressure.  Despite strong cues from Wall Street, where the S&P 500 and Nasdaq closed at record highs, supported by easing geopolitical tensions in the Middle East and strong corporate earnings, particularly from financials, the cautious undertone persists in the Indian market.  Read also: Vedanta Shares Decline Following Preliminary Investigation into Chhattisgarh Boiler Explosion  Asian markets traded lower in early hours, with Japan's Nikkei declining 0.7 percent on profit booking after recent highs, tempering sentiment in domestic equities.  Market participants remain watchful ahead of ongoing Q4 earnings announcements, with management commentary expected to guide near-term stock-specific moves. Analysts note that while broader markets continue to attract flows, large-cap stocks may face intermittent pressure due to concerns around foreign institutional investor activity at higher levels.  Technical indicators suggest that the Nifty may see immediate support in the 24,000–24,100 range, while resistance is placed between 24,350 and 24,570. A decisive move beyond these levels could determine the next directional trend.  Market participants are also closely tracking global developments, including geopolitical progress and crude oil movement, along with institutional flows, for further cues through the session.

articles.title: 86% बढ़ा कंपनी प्रॉफिट, शेयरों को खरीदने की मची होड़, 4% उछला भाव
articles.summary: A ngel Ltd Stock Jumped today: स्टॉक ब्रोकिंग कंपनी एंजल वन लिमिटेड के शेयरों का भाव आज शुक्रवार की सुबह 300 रुपये के पार पहुंच गया। कंपनी के शेयरों में तेजी के पीछे की वजह चौथी तिमाही के नतीजे हैं।
articles.body: इस दौरन कंपनी के नेट प्रॉफिट में 84 प्रतिशत का इजाफा हुआ है। वहीं, तिमाही दर तिमाही के आधार पर एंजल वन का प्रॉफिट 19 प्रतिशत बढ़ा है।  बीएसई में आज शुक्रवार को एंजल वन लिमिटेड का शेयर भारी बढ़त के साथ 304.80 रुपये के स्तर पर खुला था। दिन में कंपनी के शेयरों का भाव 305 रुपये के इंट्रा-डे हाई पर पहुंच गया।  320 करोड़ रुपये का हुआ हा प्रॉफिट (Angel One Q4 Results 2026)  कंपनी ने दी जानकारी में बताया है कि उनका प्रॉफिट (टैक्स भुगतान के बाद) 320 करोड़ रुपये रहा है। यह साल दर साल की तुलना में 84 प्रतिशत अधिक है। वहीं, तिमाही दर तिमाही के आधार पर अगर देंखे तो यह 19 प्रतिशत अधिक है। जनवरी से मार्च 2026 के दौरान एंजलवन लिमिटेड का रेवन्यू 1467 करोड़ रुपये रहा है। जोकि सालाना आधार पर 39 प्रतिशत ज्यादा है। वहीं, तिमाही दर तिमाही के आधार पर 10 प्रतिशत अधिक है।  मार्च तिमाही में कंपनी का कुल ऑर्डर 43.1 करोड़ रहा है। यह दिसंबर तिमाही की तुलना में 13 प्रतिशत अधिक है। कंपनी के ग्राहकों की संख्या भी बढ़कर 3.74 करोड़ हो गई है। मौजूदा समय में एंजल वन लिमिटेड पर भारत 16.70 प्रतिशत डिमैट अकाउंट है।  शेयरों का प्रदर्शन भी रहा है शानदार (Angle One ltd Share Performance)  महज दो हफ्ते में एंजल वन लिमिटेड के शेयरों की कीमतों में 24.44 प्रतिशत की तेजी देखने को मिली है। वहीं, 6 महीने में यह स्टॉक 19.99 प्रतिशत का रिटर्न दिया है। एक साल में कंपनी ने पोजीशनल निवेशकों को 27.18 प्रतिशत का रिटर्न दिया है। इस दौरान सेंसेक्स इंडेक्स में 0.26 प्रतिशत की गिरावट आई है।  तीन साल में एंजल वन लिमिटेड के शेयरों का भाव 135 प्रतिशत बढ़ा है। वहीं, 5 साल में के शेयरों की कीमतों में 827 प्रतिशत की तेजी आई है।  10 टुकड़ों में बंट चुका है शेयर (Angel One Dividend and Stock Split history)  एंजल वन लिमिटेड के शेयरों का बंटवारा फरवरी 2026 में हुआ था। कंपनी के शेयरों का बंटवारा तब 10 हिस्सों में हुआ था। जिसके बाद कंपनी के शेयरों की फेस वैल्यू 10 रुपये से घटकर 1 रुपये प्रति शेयर हो गई है। बता दें, जनवरी के महीने में एंजल वन लिमिटेड के शेयर एक्स-डिविडेंड ट्रेड किए थे। तब कंपनी ने एक शेयर पर 23 रुपये का डिविडेंड दिया था।  (यह निवेश की सलाह नहीं है। शेयर बाजार जोखिमों के अधीन है। किसी भी निवेश से पहले एक्सपर्ट्स की सलाह जरूर लें।)   livehindustan.com

articles.title: Hold Wipro; target of Rs 200: ICICI Securities
articles.summary: ICICI Securities recommended hold rating on Wipro with a target price of Rs 200 in its research report dated April 17, 2026.
articles.body: ICICI Securities research report on Wipro Top-line headwinds for Wipro continue with yet another weak organic guidance of -1.8% QoQ CC at the midpoint for Q1FY27. The disconnect between deal bookings growth and revenue growth could be due to higher AI-led deflation and market share loss. However, we note that top 10 clients grew at 1.8% YoY vs. a 0.3% YoY USD decline in total revenue for FY26. While margins were strong in Q4, investments in large deals, AI platform business and a 2-month incremental wage hike are likely to exert pressure on margins in FY27. Adjustments for the buyback and currency depreciation have offset the cut in revenue and other income estimates, leading to +2% EPS change for FY27E and FY28E. Outlook We continue to value Wipro at 14x on FY28E EPS of INR 14 to arrive at TP of INR 200; maintain HOLD. We note a downside risk to the valuation multiple if revenue growth trajectory does not recover by Q2FY27. articles.title: HDFC AMC jumps 5% post Q4 results; Motilal Oswal retains buy for 18% upside
articles.summary: Listen to This Article  HDFC share price today: Shares of HDFC Asset Management Company (AMC) gained nearly 5 per cent in early trade today
articles.body: after the company reported strong numbers in the March quarter (Q4FY26). HDFC AMC shares made a high of ₹2,789 on the National Stock Exchange (NSE). As of 10:35 AM, HDFC AMC shares were up 4.7 per cent at ₹2,788, with 0.8 million equities changing hands, according to NSE data.  HDFC AMC has reported 2.4 per cent decline in consolidated profit after tax (PAT) at ₹622.66 crore for the three months ended March 2026. The company had posted a PAT of ₹638.46 crore in the year-ago period. Its revenue from operations grew 17 per cent Y-o-Y to ₹1,051.51 crore in the quarter under review. For full FY26, the fund house's profit grew 16 per cent Y-o-Y to ₹2,858.06 crore, and revenue from operations rose 18 per cent to ₹4,122.16 crore.  In another related development, the board of HDFC AMC has recommended a final dividend of ₹54 per equity share for financial year ended March 31, 2026.  Meanwhile, Motilal Oswal has reiterated its 'Buy' rating on HDFC AMC shares for a target price of ₹3,170, while highlighting that its non-mutual fund (non-MF) business will drive incremental growth going forward. The target implies an upside of around 17 per cent from the CMP.  The brokerage said that HDFC AMC has reported in line revenue and that profitability remained healthy, with Ebitda rising 16 per cent Y-o-Y to ₹850 crore in the fourth quarter. FY26's Ebitda increased by 18 per cent Y-o-Y.  The brokerage said that it broadly retains its earnings estimates for FY26–FY28, expecting the asset manager's revenue to grow at a CAGR of 13 per cent, Ebitda at 14 per cent, PAT at 15 per cent, and AUM at 16 per cent over FY26–28.  The brokerage noted that HDFC AMC is diversifying beyond its core mutual fund business into alternatives, portfolio management services (PMS), and international offerings, which are expected to support long-term growth. On the mutual fund front, the company launched seven new schemes during the year. The company added 3.5 million investors (almost half of net industry additions), taking the total unique investor count for the company to 16.7 million.  Motilal Oswal said that HDFC AMC remains a strong player in the mutual fund industry, backed by robust financial and fund performance, steady AUM growth, best-in-class cost efficiency, and a strong retail presence. Despite short-term market volatilities, the company's long-term fundamentals remain solid.  HDFC AMC is an Investment Manager for HDFC Mutual Fund, one of the leading mutual funds in the country.
